title: KURT stores every x87 step of z^4 and the sample prefactor, drifting 74 ULP on KURT(1,2,3,5)
statement: In Excel 16.0 builds 20430 and 20527, KURT requires at least 4 numbers and nonzero sum of squares, storing every arithmetic operation from x87 precision 64: two-pass mean and sumsq, s = sqrt_x87(sumsq / (n - 1)), each z = (v - mean) / s, (z^2)^2 summed in order, and coeff * fourths - offset where coeff = n*(n+1)/((n-1)*(n-2)*(n-3)) and offset = 3*(n-1)^2/((n-2)*(n-3)). On =KURT(1,2,3,5), this accumulated rounding gives 0.34285714285714697 (0x3fd5f15f15f15f60), 74 ULP above the exact 12/35 (0x3fd5f15f15f15f16). All 4,508 full-bank KURT rows match.
basis: Measured in Excel 16.0.20527.20088 (prefix_metadata row 138) and CalcFunc-Evidence cache/oracle-20430/build-20430/KURT.jsonl.gz (Excel 16.0 build 20430); 4,508/4,508 full-bank KURT rows match.
